1.1.evidence:
Therefore, the Government of West Southeast Maluku Regency is obliged to provide protection to women and children victims of acts of violence which is an implementation of various laws and regulations, including Law Number 39 Year 1999 concerning Human Rights, Law Number 23 Year 2004 concerning Elimination of Domestic Violence, Law Number 21 Year 2007 concerning Eradication of the Crime of Trafficking in Persons, Law Number 23 Year 2002 concerning Child Protection.
The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to provide protection and services to women and children victims of violence based on gender and the best interests of children that occur in the household and/or public.
